title: Japanese-Style Coconut Matcha Chia Pudding
summary: A creamy vegan chia pudding made with coconut milk, maple syrup and a gentle matcha-inspired green tea flavour using pantry-friendly ingredients. It is a cool, lightly sweet dessert that works well made ahead.
steps: Put the chia seeds, coconut milk, desiccated coconut, maple syrup, vanilla extract and salt in a bowl or jug. Whisk very thoroughly for about 1 minute so the chia seeds are evenly suspended.
Leave for 10 minutes, then whisk again to break up any clumps and make the texture smooth.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or overnight, until thick, creamy and spoonable.
Stir the pudding before serving. If it is thicker than you like, loosen it with a small splash of water or extra coconut milk.
Spoon into 4 small bowls and top with sliced strawberries and sesame seeds.
